description: This Java source file defines an immutable class `ImmutableFeatureProperties` which implements the `FeatureProperties` interface. It provides methods to create, access, modify, and serialize feature property data represented as a JSON object, with support for validation and schema-aware filtering.

classes.name: ImmutableFeatureProperties
classes.description: An immutable implementation of the `FeatureProperties` interface that wraps a `JsonObject` and provides methods for property access and mutation.
